name: @pipeworx/mcp-newton

tools.name: simplify
tools.description: Reduce a mathematical expression to its simplest form. Input algebraic notation (e.g., "2^2+2(2)"). Returns simplified result.

tools.name: derive
tools.description: Find the derivative of an expression with respect to x. Input algebraic notation (e.g., "x^2"). Returns the derivative.

tools.name: integrate
tools.description: Find the indefinite integral of an expression with respect to x. Input algebraic notation (e.g., "x^2"). Returns antiderivative with constant C.

tools.name: factor
tools.description: Factor a polynomial into irreducible factors. Input polynomial (e.g., "x^2-1" or "x^2+3x+2"). Returns factored form.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-newton forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the newton pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
